title: 升降式水閘門吊裝
summary: 本課以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為主線，先用矩形門葉靜水力與水壓中心與輪載界定水力與構造條件，再將上提力與水動力、鋼索彈性與行程連結到洩量率定與交接。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks through Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force and Pressure center and wheel reactions, then connects Hoisting force and hydraulic load and Rope elasticity and travel to Discharge rating and handover. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查矩形門葉靜水力：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN；再獨立檢查水壓中心與輪載：Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m。敏感度：輪載600kN不變而滾動阻力係數由0.01增為0.03，阻力由6增至18kN；此增量應連結實測輪軸狀態，不能把所有阻力都以同一固定係數涵蓋。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 將定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. Independently examine Pressure center and wheel reactions: Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m. Sensitivity: for a600kN wheel load, increasing the rolling-resistance coefficient from0.01 to0.03 raises resistance from6 to18kN. Relate this change to observed wheel conditions instead of assigning one coefficient to every resistance mechanism. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Use the following independent check: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「矩形門葉靜水力」與「水壓中心與輪載」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" and "Pressure center and wheel reactions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「矩形門葉靜水力」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。 驗證時應核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「矩形門葉靜水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case. With water on both sides or partial immersion, integrate each pressure field and obtain the net action instead of using full upstream load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「矩形門葉靜水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「矩形門葉靜水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" is correct?
options: 上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力
平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。

quiz.explanationEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「矩形門葉靜水力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「矩形門葉靜水力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

quiz.explanationEn: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「矩形門葉靜水力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Diagnose it by the following check: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 洩量率定與交接：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Discharge rating and handover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洩量率定與交接」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Discharge rating and handover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘門開度不是流量本身，兩側水位、收縮係數與淹沒會共同控制洩量。自由孔流算例只示範特定工況，不適用所有開度與尾水；交接應包含實測率定、位置校正及異常訊號的追查方式，使操作資料與實體閘門一致。 驗證時應將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表，並辨識以下失效情境：位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洩量率定與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Opening is not discharge: heads, contraction and submergence control the relation. A free-orifice example covers one condition, not every opening or tailwater. Handover should include measured ratings, position calibration and anomaly tracing so operational records correspond to the installed gate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Discharge rating and handover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 洩量率定與交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Discharge rating and handover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洩量率定與交接」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Discharge rating and handover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed free underflow: Cd=0.65; width=4 m; opening=0.5 m; head=3 m; Q=0.65*4*0.5*sqrt(2*9.81*3)=9.97364 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed free underflow: Cd=0.65; width=4 m; opening=0.5 m; head=3 m; Q=0.65*4*0.5*sqrt(2*9.81*3)=9.97364 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 洩量率定與交接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Discharge rating and handover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洩量率定與交接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Discharge rating and handover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 洩量率定與交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Discharge rating and handover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洩量率定與交接」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Discharge rating and handover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。診斷時應採取以下查核：將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
